title: bug: VS Code SettingsPanel says 'Settings saved.' when the UPDATE_SETTINGS send failed
description:
Found in the CQ-I06f whole-epic review at 96f7bdd4 (I04 residual). MoeDaemonClient.sendMessage returns false when nothing was sent (MoeDaemonClient.ts:767). updateSettings (:902-904) discards that result and returns void, so SettingsPanel.handleMessage (:75-78) always shows 'Settings saved.' and disposes the panel, even while disconnected. Other routes already warn 'Not connected to Moe daemon' (e.g. TaskDetailPanel reopen).
Fix: return the boolean, and on false show a warning and keep the panel open. Add a settings-wire test.
definitionOfDone: A disconnected save shows a not-connected warning, does not say 'Settings saved.', and keeps the panel open; a connected save is unchanged.
A moe-vscode node:test covers both branches.
cd moe-vscode && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test pass in a snapshot.
